# [pwgen Knowledge Hub](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/)

> Documentation for pwgen, the Unix password generator compiled to WebAssembly for the CLI, Custom Elements, ESM, Node.js, and the web. Published with ShadowClaw.

## Docs

- [README](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/README.md): Overview and local development
- [AGENTS.md](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI agents working on this hub

- [Home](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main)

- [CLI Usage, Options & Node.js Integration](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/cli-and-flags)
- [C to WebAssembly Compilation Pipeline](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/wasm-and-compilation)
- [Native Custom Element (x-pwgen) & Framework Integration](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/custom-element-and-web-integration)
- [Historical Evolution: Web Bundles (.wbn) & WAPM Distribution](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/historical-targets-wbn-wapm)
- [Password Security, Phonetics & Deterministic SHA1 Seeding](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/security-entropy-and-sha1)
- [Web Platform Optimization & PWA Performance Engineering](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/web-platform-and-performance)
- [Agent Skills, Declarative Tools & Slash Commands](https://kherrick.github.io/pwgen-knowledge-hub/main/agent-skills-and-tools)
